title: Policy 463.8 (Sep 2026 revision) — approval, criteria, and review records for current sharing relationships
summary:
Asks for the records the revised Policy 463 (Lexipol date 2026/09/11) says the Department keeps for in-state ALPR network-sharing relationships. "Current relationship" is defined as each in-state network-sharing relationship in effect on the date of the request (2026-09-27):

- Item 1: for each current relationship, the record of the Department's approval, including the basis for the decision, as maintained under 463.8's Documentation provision.
- Item 2: for each current relationship, the record of the determinations made under 463.8's Approval Criteria (a) through (e).
- Item 3: for each current relationship, the agency's written request under 463.8(a) and the approved request retained on file under 463.8(c).
- Item 4: the written criteria for evaluating in-state network-sharing requests that the ALPR Program Administrator is to establish and maintain under 463.8's Approval Criteria provision.
- Item 5: any record designating the person or position serving as ALPR Program Administrator.
- Item 6: any record of a denial, periodic review, suspension, or termination of an in-state network-sharing relationship made on or after 2026-09-11.
- Item 7: records reflecting the approval and effective date of the 2026/09/11 revision — e.g. a Chief of Police approval, a Lexipol publication or acknowledgment record, or a department-wide transmittal.

The six executed ALPR Data Sharing Agreements produced under W013261-081826 (Belmont, Brisbane, CHP, Foster City, Palo Alto, South San Francisco) need not be produced again. If the Department contends any of them is the record responsive to item 1, 2, or 3 for that agency, the request asks it to identify which agreement and which portion reflects the agency's written request, the Department's approval, and the basis for the decision. The items seek internal memoranda, forms, approval notations, and platform administrative records, in native format; no review of any inbound vendor-email corpus is requested.

policy_promises.quote: The Department shall maintain records of all approvals, denials, periodic reviews, suspensions, and terminations of in-state ALPR network-sharing relationships. Such records shall include the basis for each decision
policy_promises.tests: Whether an approval record stating its basis exists for each relationship in effect on 2026-09-27, and whether any denial, review, suspension, or termination has been recorded since the revision.

policy_promises.quote: The ALPR Program Administrator shall establish and maintain written criteria for evaluating all requests for in-state ALPR network-sharing access. Before approving a network-sharing relationship, the ALPR Program Administrator shall determine that:
policy_promises.tests: Whether the written criteria exist, and whether the (a)-(e) determinations were recorded for each current relationship.

policy_promises.quote: The agency makes a written request for the ALPR in-state network data-sharing relationship ... The approved request is retained on file.
policy_promises.tests: Whether each current partner's written request and the approved request are on file.

policy_promises.quote: The results of the review shall be documented and retained in accordance with the Department's records retention schedule.
policy_promises.tests: Whether any periodic review has been documented since the revision took effect.

prior_pra_refs.note: Produced the six executed ALPR Data Sharing Agreements on 2026-08-25. This request excludes them from re-production and asks the Department to say whether, and where, any of them reflects the written request, the approval, and its basis.
The Department's 2026-09-28 closure of W013278 also pointed to the W013261 sharing agreements as responsive records.

filed_because: Revised Policy 463, bearing Lexipol date 2026/09/11 and now posted on the City's website, adds Approval Criteria, Denial Criteria, Periodic Review, Suspension or Termination, and Documentation provisions to 463.8 for in-state ALPR network-sharing relationships, and assigns the evaluation criteria to a new ALPR Program Administrator role. Each provision describes a record the Department is to keep. This asks for those records for every relationship in effect on the filing date, plus the record that designates the Program Administrator and the record that approved the revision itself.
notes:
Filed 2026-09-27 (portal receipt 9/27/2026 2:37 AM); 10-day statutory determination due 2026-10-07. Addressed to the San Mateo Police Department.

The item 1-3 scope is set by the filing date rather than by the six agencies named in W013261, so any partner added after W013261's production falls within it. Each item asks to be answered separately. The scope note (Department approval, determination, and review records only; no inbound vendor-email review) is stated in the request itself.

2026-10-07: closed (Kelly O'Keefe, Police Technical Services Administrator). Response letter, item by item:
- Items 1-3: the six agreements produced under W013261 "are considered responsive," with additional records in the attachments: nine "ALPR Sharing Emails" Outlook printouts of Lt. Casazza's threads with Belmont, Brisbane, CHP, East Palo Alto, Foster City, Hillsborough, Palo Alto, San Bruno and South San Francisco (dated 2026-07-20 to 2026-09-30).
- Item 4: "No responsive records outside of the policy."
- Items 5 and 6: no responsive records.
- Item 7: `Policy_Acknowledgement_Record.pdf`, a staff list of Policy 463 acknowledgments.

2026-10-08 (Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst): "An additional batch of records" released and the request closed again. The batch holds three executed ALPR Data Sharing Agreements, for East Palo Alto, Hillsborough and San Bruno. The parser misses the 10/8 closure line ("#W013525 -092726"), so status_override is set to closed.
